text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum's gains at 3.8% versus 1.7%, signaling stronger momentum in the largest asset while Ethereum treads more cautiously. The Fear & Greed Index at 74 (Greed) with a sharp 33-point weekly rise indicates a sharp shift toward optimism, though Bitcoin's growing dominance at 59.3% suggests conviction is concentrating in the safest major asset rather than spreading evenly across altcoins. Volume at $133B reflects solid participation backing these moves, reducing the risk this rally is merely thin-air momentum.
